newsitem.title: MEXICO: Eastman Kodak may invest $10 mln in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Kodak may invest $10 mln in Mexico.

text.p: Eastman Kodak will invest about $10 million in 1997 to enlarge its plant in Mexico's Nuevo Leon state, director of local industrial park Gerardo Hinojosa said Thursday.

"In Eastman's case we are looking at the building, the land and electronics assembly machinery for an investment of about $10 million," said the director of the site that houses Eastman Kodak's operations in the northern Mexican state.
The expanded plant will be the world's only site to assemble Eastman's new digital camera Amplix, he said.
According to Hinojosa, Fuji Photo Film Co. is also planning to expand its plant and incorporate machinery with updated technology, at a cost between $5 million and $8 million.
